    • apiVersion

      S apiVersion(@Nullable Object version)
      Set an API version for the request. The version is inserted into the request through the configured ApiVersionInserter.

      如果未设置版本，则使用配置的`defaultApiVersion`。

      如果传入 `null`，则无论默认版本设置如何，都不会插入 API 版本。

      Parameters:
      version - 请求的 API 版本；这可以是一个 String，或者是可以通过插入器格式化的某些 Object，例如通过一个ApiVersionFormatter。
      Since:
      7.0

    • retrieve

      @CheckReturnValue RestClient.ResponseSpec retrieve()
      Enter the retrieve workflow and use the returned RestClient.ResponseSpec to select from a number of built-in options to extract the response. For example: 
      ResponseEntity<Person> entity = client.get()
    .uri("/persons/1")
    .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    .retrieve()
    .toEntity(Person.class);

      或者，如果只对正文感兴趣：

      Person person = client.get()
    .uri("/persons/1")
    .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    .retrieve()
    .body(Person.class);
      Note that this method does not actually execute the request until you call one of the returned RestClient.ResponseSpec. Use the exchange(ExchangeFunction) variants if you need to separate request execution from response extraction.

      默认情况下，4xx 响应代码会导致生成一个 HttpClientErrorException，而 5xx 响应代码会导致生成一个 HttpServerErrorException。若要自定义错误处理，请使用 onStatus 处理器。

      Returns:
      ResponseSpec 用于指定如何解码主体。

    • exchange

      default <T extends @Nullable Object> T exchange(RestClient.RequestHeadersSpec.ExchangeFunction<T> exchangeFunction)
      Exchange the ClientHttpResponse for a value of type T. This can be useful for advanced scenarios, for example to decode the response differently depending on the response status: 
      Person person = client.get()
    .uri("/people/1")
    .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    .exchange((request, response) -> {
        if (response.getStatusCode().equals(HttpStatus.OK)) {
            return deserialize(response.getBody());
        }
        else {
            throw new BusinessException();
        }
    });

      注意： 在调用交换函数后，响应已关闭。

      Type Parameters:
      T - 响应将被转换成的类型
      Parameters:
      exchangeFunction - 用于处理响应的函数
      Returns:
      exchange 函数返回的值，可能为null。
      See Also:
      • exchangeForRequiredValue(RequiredValueExchangeFunction)

    • exchange

      <T extends @Nullable Object> T exchange(RestClient.RequestHeadersSpec.ExchangeFunction<T> exchangeFunction, boolean close)
      Exchange the ClientHttpResponse for a value of type T. This can be useful for advanced scenarios, for example to decode the response differently depending on the response status: 
      Person person = client.get()
    .uri("/people/1")
    .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    .exchange((request, response) -> {
        if (response.getStatusCode().equals(HttpStatus.OK)) {
            return deserialize(response.getBody());
        }
        else {
            throw new BusinessException();
        }
    });

      注意： 如果 close 为 true，则在调用交换函数后，响应将被关闭。当设置为false时，调用者负责关闭响应。

      Type Parameters:
      T - 响应将被转换成的类型
      Parameters:
      exchangeFunction - 用于处理响应的函数
      close - 在调用exchangeFunction后关闭响应，设为true；保持响应打开，设为false。
      Returns:
      exchange 函数返回的值，可能为null。
      See Also:
      • exchangeForRequiredValue(RequiredValueExchangeFunction, boolean)
